_note: SPLICE-BACK SEGMENT, not a standalone video. This is the 0:00–1:04:16 talking-head head of 'tribunal trial.mp4' (the DaVinci cut), re-rendered with overlays so it can REPLACE the first clip on V1. Three rules follow from that: fps is 60 to match the host timeline (a 30fps render judders at the splice); bodyMs pins the output to exactly 3856 frames because the stream-copy extract overshoots to the next packet boundary at 3861; and there is no end card, no music bed and no captions — the rest of the cut has none, and adding them for one minute reads as a different video. Beat times are seconds read off a whisper transcript of the segment, NOT eyeballed. Graphics sit in the gaps between spoken points, so ~0–9.8s, 26.6–33.8s and 44.6–64.3s are deliberately clean.
